tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warm white, never pure white, so surfaces read as lifted from it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, chips, the tray. Every composed component sits on this.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Warm relief inside a card: the action card ground, a selected question chip.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text. 16.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, mono text, and the neutral mark on empty lists. 5.9:1 on surface; the floor for any text on bg or surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines that draw in: row underlines, chip borders, the strip rule.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Card borders, card-header rules, chart grid.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border on fields, the hero repo field and chips. 1.57:1: an affordance, not identity, so it does not need 3:1; the label and the focus ring carry identification.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue, coral. Marks what the model chose: insight rule, metric bars, chart lines, primary button, selected chip borders. 4.8:1 on surface but 4.49:1 on surface-tint, so words in the accent use accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Violet. Only ever the far end of an accent gradient (bars, insight rule, primary button). Never alone.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent or on the accent gradient.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as words: links, Try again, Show all, View drafts. 5.38:1 on surface, 4.99:1 on surface-tint, where plain accent drops to 4.49:1. Marks, bars and rings stay accent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Warm near-ink, 13.04:1 on surface. Never accent, which a reader can't tell from a crit error border.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Positive text: approved tag, additions, good delta. 5.8:1 on surface; 4.68:1 on its own tag tint over surface-tint, the darkest ground it sits on.

tokens.name: good-fill
tokens.usage: Positive marks: dots, chart bars, legend swatches. Never text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Waiting text: review pending tag, aging delta. Honey, not mustard. 5.8:1 on surface; 4.73:1 on its own tag tint over surface-tint.

tokens.name: warn-fill
tokens.usage: Waiting marks: dashed dots, bars. Never text.

tokens.name: crit
tokens.usage: Blocking text: changes requested, failing, deletions, critical delta. Crimson, so it never reads as the coral accent. 7.49:1 on surface, 6.96:1 on surface-tint, 5.87:1 on its own tag tint over surface-tint.

tokens.name: crit-fill
tokens.usage: Blocking marks: filled dots, failing bars, the hot-card border. Never text. Crimson, a 20° hue step from accent: 6.62:1 on surface, 1.37:1 against accent, OKLab ΔE 9.2 (protan 10.5, deutan 8.2).

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, the series the story is about. Lines, bars, endpoint dots. Never text.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2, slate. 5.30:1 on surface; validated against data-1 for color-blind separation (ΔE 17.5) and normal vision (ΔE 25.5). Never more than two categorical series.

tokens.name: data-ref
tokens.usage: A reference or previous-period series, and the bars outside a ContributorRank wall. 3.30:1 on surface, 3.06:1 on surface-tint, so hovered rows keep their marks above the 3:1 floor.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Heatmap cell with no events. Distinct from heat-1 by hue as well as lightness.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 1 of 5, one coral hue light to dark. Light steps sit under 3:1 by design; every cell has a tooltip and the chart a table view.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 2 of 5.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 3 of 5.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 4 of 5. 3.74:1 on surface.

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 5 of 5, the peak. 5.67:1 on surface.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added line ground in a DiffView: good at 8% over surface. Text stays ink (14.47:1); a + sign carries direction.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Removed line ground in a DiffView: crit at 8% over surface. Text stays ink (14.15:1); a − sign carries direction.

tokens.name: diff-add-word
tokens.usage: Word-level highlight inside an added line, only on equal-length paired runs.

tokens.name: diff-del-word
tokens.usage: Word-level highlight inside a removed line, only on equal-length paired runs: crit at 16% over surface. Ink 12.27:1.

tokens.name: glow-a
tokens.usage: Cursor warmth, inner ring, and the accent bloom on cards the model flagged.

tokens.name: glow-b
tokens.usage: Cursor warmth, outer ring.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The drawer and overlay backdrop: ink at 10%. Added in the build kit (decision 49).

styles.name: question
styles.usage: The question the screen answers. Fluid down to 28px on phones. Enters by wipe.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The number inside a Metric. Tabular figures, one decimal at most. 30px compact, 38px comfortable, 46px spacious. Enters by count.

styles.name: built
styles.usage: The composed-in latency figure in the header.

styles.name: insight
styles.sample: v16.2 is held by three pull requests still waiting on review.
styles.usage: The one sentence the model writes. Max 60ch. Fluid down to 16px.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: First line of a list row. One line, ellipsis.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Metric label, in muted. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: A number or value set beside a row title, like a share or a count. Added in the build kit (decision 2).

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Helper and validation lines under a field, in muted. Added in the build kit (decision 2).

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings on the catalog, evals and about pages. Added in the build kit (decision 2).

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The system sentence in the Insight slot on Warming and RateLimit screens. Added in the build kit (decision 49).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata, deltas, sources, the build strip. Interpuncts between facts, never dashes.

styles.name: suffix
styles.usage: Unit or denominator after a metric number, in muted, baseline aligned, space-2 after it. 12px compact, 14px comfortable, 16px spacious.

styles.name: axis
styles.usage: Chart axis labels only, in muted. Raised from 9px, which was too small to read at arm's length.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Diff lines, file tree names, code paths. 12px at every density so the column count never changes; density sets line height to 18, 20 or 22px. Ligatures off.

styles.name: handle
styles.usage: A GitHub handle in a row. Added in the build kit (decision 2).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, buttons, legend items. Height of a rank bar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card's grid and between a row's parts. Card top and bottom padding at compact density.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards. Card grid gutters. Side padding for cards and rows at compact density.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Side padding for cards and rows at comfortable density.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between screen regions (insight, metrics, columns, strip). Side padding for cards and rows at spacious density.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Breathing room above the tray; hero-scale spacing on the about page.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Bar ends, heatmap keys, chart keys. Added in the build kit (decision 1).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Marks that extend: metric bars, rank bars, legend swatches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards. The system's signature curve.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, the tray.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Every card at rest. Warm, low, wide.

tokens.name: card-hover
tokens.usage: A clickable card or chip on hover.

tokens.name: card-hot
tokens.usage: A card the model flagged as blocking. Pairs with a crit-fill border at 35%.

tokens.name: bloom
tokens.usage: The peak of the bloom move; animates from none to this and back.

tokens.name: tray
tokens.usage: The fixed control tray only.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The floating drawer sheet. Added in the build kit (decision 49).

size.note: Fixed dimensions that are not spacing: strokes, marks, hit areas. Added in the build kit so component CSS never carries a raw pixel value.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every hairline: card borders, row rules, the spine, chart grid.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Mark outlines and the unavailable slash.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: The accent bar on a metric, the warming progress bar, the insight rule.

tokens.name: plot-line
tokens.usage: Chart lines, sparklines and their baselines.

tokens.name: spark-inset
tokens.usage: Room inside a sparkline's box, top and bottom, for the line and the dot.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: A state mark's diameter.

tokens.name: node
tokens.usage: Timeline's node: a muted point, deliberately smaller than a mark.

tokens.name: endpoint
tokens.usage: The latest point: a chart's endpoint, Timeline's newest node. Accent, the one thing that bounces.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The surface ring around a node or endpoint that parts the spine or line beneath it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring width, in the focus color.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

tokens.name: hit
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for a text action (TextLink, Try again, Show all).

tokens.name: tag-y
tokens.usage: A tag's top and bottom padding; the sides use space-2.

tokens.name: underline-offset
tokens.usage: Gap under a text link's underline.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Cursor warmth diameter.

tokens.name: spark-max
tokens.usage: Sparkline in a Metric: the widest it grows beside the number.

tokens.name: spark-min
tokens.usage: Sparkline in a Metric: below this width it drops and the delta carries the trend in words.

tokens.name: spark-row
tokens.usage: Sparkline slot in a list row, between the title block and the value.

tokens.name: row-value
tokens.usage: The right-aligned value column in a list row, so values line up down the list.

tokens.name: col-max
tokens.usage: The widest a chart column grows: failure strip columns, bar chart bars at full width.

tokens.name: label-gap
tokens.usage: The least room between two x axis labels; the axis thins to every 2nd, 3rd, 4th or 6th week to keep it.

tokens.name: band-count
tokens.usage: A week's band must be at least this wide for every failure column to carry its count.

density.note: Three levels set once on the screen root as data-density. Values are literal here so the generator can emit the three blocks; the usage notes name the spacing token each maps to.
